column3: Inventory every reachable mesh node, especially Note3 and mesh-home, across sensors, actuators, compute, connectivity, physical-device credentials, data stores, and existing-but-unwired tools; artifact: node capability matrix with command-level evidence and UNKNOWN/untested states.

Review relevant primary literature and strong surveys for distributed sensing, embodied/multimodal agents, active/self-triggered sensing, collective intelligence, resilient coordination, edge inference, and human-computer interaction; artifact: cited literature-to-mesh mapping with testable design implications.

Rank candidate mesh improvements by expected operator value, feasibility, reversibility, safety, and verification cost; artifact: prioritized proposals naming the sensing/ability gap, literature basis, affected nodes, and acceptance predicate.

Create exact-owner implementation tasks for the highest-value proposals and preserve lower-ranked/non-actionable findings with reasons; artifact: canonical mesh-task rows plus findings disposition file.

Drive and verify the first selected capabilities end to end, or document precise dependency/capability blocks and retry edges; artifact: real readings or working cross-node demonstrations, with steward handoff receipts.
